body.statement: Every compatible selector is superior to the reference intervention if and only if \(L>\theta_0\), and every compatible selector is weakly noninferior if and only if \(L\ge\theta_0\).
body.justification: The lower endpoint translates the interval into a decision-relevant control comparison.
body.gap: Béal and Latouche compare a known assignment algorithm with controls, not a deployment known only through separate margins.
body.consumer: The PDX analysis can report whether responder-rate superiority survives every calibrated allocation.
